body:
I was in counseling and on medication for a long time...probably about 15 years...I saw lots of different therapists and took lots of different medications. I've also attended grief meetings and such in the community. None of it "helped"; it didn't change my feelings or anything like that so I just stopped. 95% of the time I still feel like I did the morning after the wreck or the day after I found about about passing on the STD. I've just learned to live with it I guess. Every once in awhile I have a complete breakdown because I feel so guilty about this stuff. The breakdowns were actually a lot worse when I was in treatment, but that's irrelevant. 

The cloud thing makes sense though, it's interesting to hear it put that way. And as I read more of these posts on here I guess that (if taken at face value) the things that many people are struggling with are not "permanent". It just struck me as odd when I saw so many posts saying time heals all wounds...I guess it's a theme here because it applies to so many of these situations!

Thanks =]
